---
title: "Tumor volume by group"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(data.table)
tidy <- fread("tidy-sheet.csv")[excluded == FALSE & !is.na(tumor_volume_mm3)]
```

Excluded mice and blank volumes are left out. The reasons are in `recipe.R`.

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Tumor volume by group, all days pooled."
boxplot(tumor_volume_mm3 ~ group, data = tidy, ylab = "Volume (mm3)", xlab = "")
stripchart(tumor_volume_mm3 ~ group, data = tidy, vertical = TRUE, method = "jitter", add = TRUE, pch = 16)
```

```{r}
knitr::kable(tidy[, .(n = .N, mean_mm3 = round(mean(tumor_volume_mm3), 1), sd_mm3 = round(sd(tumor_volume_mm3), 1)), by = .(group, day)])
```
